messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — my PR (feature/gating-telemetry) is blocked in the merge queue. integ shard5 keeps failing with a snapshot mismatch and occasional timeout. Can someone take a quick look?
Samir Chen: On it. Which PR?
Priya Patel: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/15888 — only changed ordering for metric tags, didn’t touch serializer logic.
Alex Morgan: I glanced at the logs earlier — failing test is telemetry/serializer_test::roundtrip on macOS shard. I see `checksum mismatch` and a final gRPC timeout. @CI Bot can you attach artifacts?
CI Bot: Build 4821 artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4821/artifacts (logs, core dumps, test outputs)
Jordan Wells: Did you intentionally update any golden/snapshot files in that PR?
Priya Patel: No snapshots were touched. My change just reorders some metric tags for deterministic export but the serializer should handle key ordering.
Samir Chen: Can you repro locally? Try: `bazel test //telemetry:serializer_test --test_output=errors` and maybe set `SEED=42` if it's nondet.
Alex Morgan: I can run a targeted rerun on shard5 once we approve. Also suggest adding `--runs_per_test=10` locally to see flakiness frequency.
Priya Patel: I pushed a tiny debug commit (adds extra logging) to help trace the checksum path. I don’t want to update snapshots unless we confirm a real behavior change.
Samir Chen: I ran the test 6 times locally, saw 2 failures. Stack snippet: ```
runtime error: checksum mismatch
  at telemetry/serializer.cc:145
  at telemetry/serialize_impl.cc:78
  at telemetry/serializer_test.cc:42
```
Alex Morgan: Sounds nondet. Plan options: targeted rerun -> if it’s flaky, either revert the ordering commit to unblock merges or add a small normalization (sort map keys) in serializer.
Priya Patel: Would prefer normalization in serializer if that’s safe. But I can revert temporarily if we need to clear the queue.
Samir Chen: I approve a targeted rerun now. cc @Jordan for quick eyes.
Jordan Wells: LGTM to rerun. Also please try `--runs_per_test=50` locally if you can spare time; helps detect rare flake patterns.
CI Bot: Targeted rerun scheduled by Alex Morgan for shard5: build 4822 (queued).
CI Bot: Build 4822 finished — FAILED — same checksum mismatch. Full logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4822/logs
Priya Patel: Ok, thanks. I’ll add a normalization step (sort keys before serializing) and push a proper fix. Avoiding snapshot bump unless this is a real change.
Alex Morgan: That sounds right. Once you push, ping and I’ll trigger another targeted rerun.
Priya Patel: Pushed fix in feature/gating-telemetry (1719001301) — added map-key sorting and a small test to assert deterministic output.
Jordan Wells: Quick glance — looks good. tiny nit (variable name), not blocking.
Alex Morgan: Triggered targeted rerun build 4823.
CI Bot: Build 4823 finished — PASSED :tada: (all tests green). Artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/4823/artifacts
Priya Patel: Nice — merging now. Thanks for the quick help everyone :shipit:
Samir Chen: Thx for handling the fix. If this recurs we should add a flakiness ticket and consider `--runs_per_test` in CI for the telemetry suite.
Jordan Wells: Agreed. Filing follow-up ticket after merge.
Priya Patel: Filed ENG-1347 to track flakiness post-merge.
Alex Morgan: Closing loop — merged and cleared from merge queue.
Priya Patel: Thanks all!
